title: PATS — information only
body: Passive Anti-Theft System (PATS) status and module roles are shown for technician context. This app does not perform PATS key programming, parameter resets, or outcode/incode procedures.
footnote: Ford PATS: info-only in Plan B. Programming requires OEM tooling and authorized workflow. SKIM/SKREEM (Stellantis) does not apply — use PATS checklists on Tier 4.
